description: Unit test class for the implementation of ConditionService, testing CRUD operations, status changes, and associations for the Condition entity in OpenMRS.

classes.name: ConditionServiceImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for testing ConditionService implementation.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveNewCondition
methods.description: Tests saving a new Condition object and verifies correct persistence and attributes.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldReplaceExistingCondition
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Condition and ensures old version is voided and new version is saved correctly.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldRetainPropertiesOfCondition
methods.description: Verifies properties of the Condition are correctly retained and cloned when saving multiple times.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldNotVoidAndRecreateIfUnchanged
methods.description: Ensures saving an unmodified Condition does not void or duplicate it.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldVoidExistingConditionAndNotCreateNewCondition
methods.description: Tests void operation on an existing Condition and checks that it is marked void and not duplicated.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldUnvoidExistingVoidedCondition
methods.description: Tests unvoiding a previously voided Condition, ensuring it is restored to active state.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveConditionAssociatedWithAnEncounter
methods.description: Verifies saving a Condition associated with a specific Encounter.

methods.name: saveCondition_shouldSaveConditionWithFormField
methods.description: Tests setting and updating form namespace and path in a Condition.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid_shouldFindConditionGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Checks retrieval of Condition by UUID.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Checks handling of invalid UUID for Condition retrieval.

methods.name: getCondition_shouldFindConditionGivenValidId
methods.description: Retrieves Condition by ID and verifies key fields.

methods.name: getActiveConditions_shouldGetActiveConditions
methods.description: Tests retrieving only active Conditions for a patient.

methods.name: getAllConditions_shouldGetAllUnvoidedConditions
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all non-voided Conditions for a patient.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter_shouldGetAllConditionsAssociatedWithAnEncounter
methods.description: Verifies fetching conditions linked to a specific Encounter.

methods.name: voidCondition_shouldVoidConditionSuccessfully
methods.description: Ensures a Condition can be successfully voided with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidCondition_shouldUnvoidConditionSuccessfully
methods.description: Verifies a voided Condition can be unvoided and restored.

methods.name: purgeCondition_shouldPurgeCondition
methods.description: Tests permanent deletion of a Condition.
